back: Budgeted fixed overhead - actual fixed overhead. Positive = favourable.
(Actual output - budgeted output) × standard fixed overhead rate per unit = overhead absorbed - budgeted overhead.
(Actual hours - budgeted hours) × standard fixed overhead rate per hour.
(Standard hours for actual output - actual hours) × standard fixed overhead rate per hour.
Capacity + efficiency = volume. Expenditure + volume = overhead absorbed - actual overhead.
Budgeted fixed overhead ÷ budgeted hours (per hour) or ÷ budgeted units (per unit).

front: Meaning of an adverse capacity variance
back: Fewer hours were worked than budgeted: idle capacity from low orders, breakdowns or strikes.

front: Meaning of an adverse efficiency variance
back: The output took more hours than the standard allows, so less overhead was absorbed.
Fixed overhead variances: Cambridge A Level only. ZIMSEC states that overhead variances will not be set.
